verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page says employees can be reimbursed in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies, paid in two days or less in their local currency. That happens inside Ramp's native reimbursement flow, which also syncs to accounting across multiple entities, so no separate international payments process is needed. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of FX rates and fees, how employee bank details are onboarded abroad, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the single marketing claim.
